chapter.verse: Tua hi a, hizahta-a tam teci lompite in eite hong uumcih ahih nungsang hong dongtangsak thei khempeuh ahi zongin, hong gakcip ziau thei mawhna ahi zongin hemkhia ni. I mai-a hong kikhunsak tai kidemna dung ah kuhkalna tawh tai ni.
Eite' upna a pankhiapa leh a cingtaaksakpa Jesu mitsuan cinten ni. Jesu in ama' mai-a kikoih thupha lungdamna hangin maizumna awlmawh lo-in singlamteh gimna nawkto a, Pasian' tokhom taklam ah tu hi.
Mawhnei mite' tungpan langbawlna hizahta-in a thuakpa ngaihsun un. Tua hileh nunna kha lungkia cih bang na om kei ding uh hi.
Mawhna tawh na kinawkna uhah thahna tuakkha zah dongin na langdo naikei uh hi.
Tua hi a, ta ci-in note hong samin hong thapiakna a nuai-a kam mangngilh khin na hi uh hiam? “Ka ta aw, Topa' hong hilh hong sekna zangkhai ngaihsut kei inla khialhna hong lah ciangin lungkia kei in.
A hang pen Topa in ama' it mi hilhin sek a, ta ci-a a san khempeuh khauhtak gawt hi.”
Note pen Pasian in tate bangin hong bawl ahih manin hilhna sekna a thuak ding mah na hi uh hi. A hang pen zuapa' hilhloh sekloh tanu tapa cih bang om ahi hiam?
Vekpi' tuahkhak tek hilhna sekna a tuakkha lo na hih uhleh sungsuakta na hikei uh a, zawlta na hi uh hi.
Tua banah eite hong hilh hong sek dingin leitung zuapate i nei a, amaute zong thupisim lai buang i hihleh kha thu tawh kisai i Zuapa' nuai-ah niamlutin i nuntak ding hizaw kan lo ahi hiam?

A hang pen leitung zuapate in hoihpen dinga a ngaihsut bangun hun tomno sung' adingin eite hong hilh hong sek uh hi. Kha Zuapa ahihleh ama' sianthona eite in ngahin i hamphatpih nading hong hilh hong sek ahi hi.
A hang pen hilhna sekna ahih nakleh lungdam nading sangin dah nading tawh kibangzaw thei a, ahi zongin tua bang a sinkhate' tungah diktatna thu a kici, nopna lemna tawh a kidim, gahleteh piangsak hi.
Tua ahih manin a kivei nuangnuang na khutte uh leh a thanem na khukte uh khauhsak un.
Khelbaite guhletang kilawi lo thamlo-in a dam theih nadingin khe tawh na totna uh zawite tangsak un.
Mi khempeuh tawh na kilem nadingun leh a siangtho na hih nadingun hanciam un. Kuamah in sianthona lo tawh Topa mu lo ding hi.

Pasian' hehpihna a ngahkha lo a om loh nading limtak van un. Singzung kha hong pokhiat loh nading zong encik un. Hong po hileh buaina hong piangsak ding a, tua tungtawnin mi tampitak a thanghuai hong suaksak ding hi.
Tua banah annek khat ai tawh ama' pianken innluahza a zuak Esau bangin nulepa vai ah a takhial, a biaknavailo, kuamah a om loh nading encik un.
A hang pen Esau zong tua khit nungah thupha a luahnop hun ciangin khitui naptui tawh thum himah taleh kisik nading hunpha a ngah nawnloh manin nolhna tuakkha cih na thei uh hi.
Banghanghiam cihleh note pen lawnkhaktheih mual ciangdong na tung kei uh hi. Meikuang, khuamial sahpi, lungzinna leh huihpi ginngaih ahi zongin,
pengkul tumna awging ahi zongin, thu kigen a zate in bangmah a kigenbeh nawnloh nading a thum zah dong uh a piangsak awging ahi zongin, hihte na tuakkha kei uh hi.
A hang pen amaute in, “Gamsa nangawn mual a sukkhak leh suang tawh kidenglum ding hi,” cihna thupiak thuakzo lo uh hi.
Tua mitmuh-a kilang pen kihtak-huai lua ahih manin Moses in, “Lau-in ka ling hi,” ci hi.
Ahi zongin note' tunna pen Zion Mual leh a nungta Pasian' khuapi ahi vantung Jerusalem hi a, pawi bawl dinga kikaikhawm simzawhloh vanmite' omna mun,
vantung ah min a kikhumsa tacilte' pawlpi hitaleh, na khempeuh' tunga thukhen mangpi Pasian hitaleh, a cingtaak dinga kibawl midikte' khate hitaleh,
thuciamna thak kamkhapna palai Jesu hitaleh, Abel' sisan sangin a hoihzaw thu khat a genkhia sisan a kitheh hitaleh, tu-a teng a omna mun ahi hi.
Thu hong genpa na nolhkhak loh ding uh kidawm un. A hang pen hih leitunga a hilhphawngpa a nolhte suakta lo uh ahihleh vantung panin a hilhphawngpa i nolh leh suakta lozaw kan ding hilo i hi hiam?
Tua hunin ama' awging in leitung lok ahih hangin tu-in ahihleh amah in kamciam hong pia khin a, “Leitung bek hilo-in vantungte zong khatvei ka lok lai ding hi,” ci hi.
Tu-in, “khatvei lai,” cih ciangin a kilinglo nate a omkip theih nadingin a kiling nate-a kipiangsak nate-kihemkhia ding cih kawktelna ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin a kiling theilo kumpigam khat i ngahna hangin lungdamin Pasian' kiangah kihtakna leh lamdangsakna tawh a santaak biakpiakna luui ni.
Banghanghiam cihleh eite' Pasian pen a kangtumsak thei meikuang ahi hi.
